lines: Two men. One test. One said: I earned it... and the earth swallowed him.
Qarun was given treasures, and said: I was only given it because of knowledge I have.
Prophet Sulaiman, alayhis salaam, was given more, and said: This is from the favor of my Lord.
About Qarun, Allah says: We caused the earth to swallow him and his home.
Same test today. Say: from the favor of my Lord.
